sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Yehudah's guarantee for Binyamin stems from the fact that all Yisrael are one essential entity, and Yehudah specifically embodies Malchus whose root is in the Kesser, above division.

translations.translation: And it may be said,
that the guarantee of Yehudah,
who bound himself with a strong bond to be etc. in both worlds,
comes from the aspect that all Yisrael are truly one essence
(above the level of being intermingled with each other).
And therefore this guarantee was specifically with Yehudah,
for Yehudah is the aspect of Malchus,
for the root of Malchus is in Kesser
(and in Kesser itself, in the innerness of Kesser)
which is above division.
And one may add,
that by Yehudah saying to Yosef, "For your servant guaranteed the youth,"
this guarantee being from the aspect that all Yisrael are one essence,
this matter was drawn
(in an encompassing manner, at least)
also to Yosef,
and therefore Yosef could not restrain himself etc.
and he made himself known to his brothers.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The explanation of "like you, like Pharaoh" is that the true root of Zeir Anpin is in the essence of Kesser, and Yehudah's statement caused this to be deposited in Yosef, leading to "bi adoni."

translations.translation: And based on this, it may be said,
that the explanation of "like you, like Pharaoh" is,
that even the true root of Zeir Anpin
(Yosef,
"like you")
is in the essence of Kesser
(above the level of Kesser which is the root of Zeir Anpin),
Pharaoh.
That is,
that the intention in the emanation of Zeir Anpin,
and also in the level of Kesser which is the root of Zeir Anpin,
is in order to complete the intention of the innerness of Kesser.
And by Yehudah
[the aspect of Malchus,
whose root is in the innerness of Kesser,
that is,
that even after it was drawn downward, its root in the innerness of Kesser is felt in it]
saying to Yosef "like you, like Pharaoh,"
there was deposited
(laid down)
this matter also in Yosef,
and this effected in him the matter of "bi adoni,"
that he should draw down influence to Malchus for the sake of Malchus,
in order to complete the intention of the innerness of Kesser.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The relationship between "bi adoni" and "like you, like Pharaoh" is that the latter is the cause of the former, and alternatively, by drawing down influence to Malchus, the revelation of the innerness of Kesser is drawn to Yosef.

translations.translation: And 4)
Now, according to this explanation,
the connection of "bi adoni" to "like you, like Pharaoh" is,
that "like you, like Pharaoh" is the cause for the matter of "bi adoni."
For by it being deposited with Yosef that the true root of Zeir Anpin
(the intention in the emanation of Zeir Anpin)
is in the innerness of Kesser,
this brought him to draw down influence to Malchus for the sake of Malchus,
in order to complete the intention of the innerness of Kesser.
And another explanation of the connection of these two matters,
that by Yosef drawing down influence to Malchus for the sake of Malchus,
"bi adoni,"
through this there will be in him a revelation of the innerness of Kesser,
"like you, like Pharaoh"
(as above, section 7).
For this, that the matter of "like you, like Pharaoh" was deposited with him before he influenced Malchus,
was
(not in a revealed manner,
but rather)
that he positioned himself to influence Malchus,
in order to complete the intention.
And by his influencing Malchus,
the revelation of the innerness of Kesser was drawn to him.
